blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Only five of the 76 people who died in the MV June Aster ferry fire off Coron, Palawan, have been identified and claimed by their families as of Monday night, authorities said. The Coron Emergency Operations Center (EOC), in its Situation Report No. 7 issued as of 8 p.m. on Monday, said the death toll was at 76, while 12 people remained missing. Forty-four others survived the tragedy. The EOC said 132 people were aboard the vessel when it caught fire –115 passengers and 17 crew members who left Manila and were bound for Coron.
